description: This file appears to be a shell script that contains various test cases for a git-p4 integration tool. It performs operations like cloning repositories, submitting changes, handling shelved changes, and editing commit descriptions, primarily for testing the functionality and behavior of the git-p4 tool.

methods.name: make_job
methods.description: Creates a new P4 job with a specified name, modifying the output of 'p4 job -o' to set the Job: field, adds a description line, and submits the job.

methods.name: last_shelve
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change list number by parsing the output of 'p4 -G changes -s shelved'.

methods.name: make_shelved_cl
methods.description: Creates and submits a shelved changelist with a specific commit message, then returns its change number.
